name: Elise
title: the Spider Queen
lore: Elise is a deadly predator who dwells in a shuttered, lightless palace, deep within the oldest city of Noxus. Once mortal, she was the mistress of a powerful house, but the bite of a vile demigod transformed her into something beautiful, yet utterly inhuman—a spider-like creature, drawing unsuspecting prey into her web. To maintain her eternal youth, Elise now prefers to feed upon the naive and the faithless, and there are few who can resist her seductions.

passive.name: Spider Queen
passive.description:
Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling.

Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.

damage.name: spell.EliseR:PassiveTotalDamage
notModeled: a passive value that changes with a rank (PassiveBonusDamage)

spells.name: Neurotoxin
spells.description: Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.

damage.name: HumanPercentHealth
notModeled: a percentage, such as a share of the target's health

spells.name: Volatile Spiderling
spells.description: Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target.

spells.name: Cocoon
spells.description: Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.

spells.name: Spider Form
spells.description: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.

Q.name: Venomous Bite
Q.description: Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.

W.name: Skittering Frenzy
W.description: Elise and her Spiderlings gain a burst of Attack Speed.

E.name: Rappel
E.description: Ascends into the air, briefly becoming untargetable, and then descends upon an enemy.

R.name: Human Form
R.description: Transforms into Human Form, removing Spider Form bonuses but granting the ability to generate new Spiderlings by casting spells.
